title: A Stick with Ideas
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：tree　|　正文 333 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 tree 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: There was one ① tree in the yard, a pear, planted in 1931 by a man who does not appear in the ② family tree because he was not family at all, and my grandmother said that is the whole point of a tree: it outlives everybody who could explain it.

In 1957 my father cut a ③ Christmas tree out of the hedge, and my grandmother said they were not a family who did that, and they did it anyway, and the tree was eleven inches tall and everybody pretended not to notice. She used to say that ④ money does not grow on trees, and my father said it does on that one, and he was right: the pear sold for eleven pounds a box in 1961, which was a month's wages.

In 1974 the bank had my father ⑤ up a tree, and he sold the yard and kept the house, and my grandmother said a man who sells the tree has sold the wrong thing, and she was right, and it took him eleven years to get the yard back.

The ⑥ tree line on the hill behind the house is at three hundred metres and has not moved in a hundred years, and the eleven trees above it are all the same height, which my grandfather said was the wind and the soil and not God. For eleven years he was ⑦ at the top of the tree among the growers in that county, meaning he set the price and everybody else followed, and he never once went to a meeting about it.

When the pear came down in 1998, my brother sold the ⑧ tree as timber to a man in the next county and made eleven boxes out of what was left. The ⑨ tree I planted in 2011 is eleven years old and has never fruited, and my daughter says it is not a ⑩ tree yet but a stick with ideas, and I have decided she is right, and I have decided to wait.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 木料；木材；树木（作为材料）
C. 固定搭配：family tree 家谱；族谱
D. 固定搭配：Christmas tree 圣诞树
E. 固定搭配：money doesn't grow on trees 钱不是树上长出来的
F. 固定搭配：up a tree 进退两难；一筹莫展
G. 固定搭配：at the top of the tree 位居（行业）顶峰
H. 固定搭配：tree line 林线；树木生长的上限

items.q: There was one tree in the yard
does not appear in the family tree
my father cut a Christmas tree out of the hedge
money does not grow on trees
the bank had my father up a tree
The tree line on the hill behind the house
he was at the top of the tree among the growers
my brother sold the tree as timber
it is not a tree yet

answers.why: a tree 意为“树”，院子里只有一棵树，一棵梨树，1931 年种的。
family tree 意为“家谱、族谱”，种树的那个人不出现在家谱上，因为他根本不是家里人。
Christmas tree 意为“圣诞树”，1957 年父亲从树篱上砍了一棵圣诞树。
money doesn't grow on trees 意为“钱不是树上长出来的、钱来之不易”，祖母常这么说。
up a tree 意为“进退两难、一筹莫展”，1974 年银行把我父亲逼得走投无路。
tree line 意为“林线、树木生长的上限”，屋后山上的林线在三百米，一百年没有移动过。
at the top of the tree 意为“位居行业顶峰”，他有十一年在那一带果农中位居顶尖：他定价，别人跟着。
the tree 意为“作为材料的树木、木料”，我哥哥把那棵树当木料卖给了邻县的人。
the tree 意为“树”，我 2011 年种的那棵树已经十一年了，从未结过果。
a tree 意为“树”，我女儿说它还不是一棵树，只是一根有想法的棍子。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 院子里只有一棵树，一棵梨树，是 1931 年一个不在这本家谱上的人种的。（tree / family tree）
1957 年父亲从树篱上砍了一棵圣诞树，只有十一英寸高。（Christmas tree）
祖母常说钱不是树上长出来的，父亲说这棵树就是。（money doesn't grow on trees）
1974 年银行把他逼得走投无路，他卖掉了园子，留下了房子。（up a tree）
他有十一年在那一带果农中位居顶尖：他定价，别人跟着。（at the top of the tree）
1998 年梨树倒下时，我哥哥把它当木料卖了，剩下的做了十一个箱子。（tree）
answers: There was one tree in the yard, a pear, planted in 1931 by a man who does not appear in the family tree.
In 1957 my father cut a Christmas tree out of the hedge, and it was eleven inches tall.
She used to say that money does not grow on trees, and my father said it does on that one.
In 1974 the bank had my father up a tree, and he sold the yard and kept the house.
For eleven years he was at the top of the tree among the growers in that county: he set the price and everybody else followed.
When the pear came down in 1998, my brother sold the tree as timber and made eleven boxes out of what was left.

answers: There was one tree in the yard, a pear, planted in 1931 by a man who does not appear in the family tree.
